evidence: cross-review of the Dependabot shadow report; the new tests "mergeCallComments keeps 1 comment for each id and orders the calls by created_at" and "the collector reads the own comments of a Dependabot pull request that holds no call in the window" in test/dependabot-shadow-report.test.mjs
